shellCommands.command:
export BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke-books.json && rm -f $BOOKS_FILE && node server.js & sleep 1
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/books -d "title=The Left Hand of Darkness&author=Ursula K. Le Guin&notes=First+one+of+ hers" -o /dev/null -w "add: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n"
ID=$(basename $(curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o '/books/[A-Za-z0-9_-]*' | head -1))
echo "id=$ID"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -o 'Le Guin\|First one of hers\|Share this book'
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/books/$ID/finish -o /dev/null -w "finish: %{http_code}\n"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -o 'Finished [A-Za-z ]*'
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o 'Currently reading ([0-9]*)\|Finished ([0-9]*)'
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/badid -o /dev/null -w "bad id: %{http_code}\n"
kill %1; cat /tmp/smoke-books.json
